docs.summary: Fluent builder for an Origami text field. One builder covers the common variations: plain text, search, password, multi-line, with optional autocomplete.
docs.remarks:
Visual structure: an outer focusable row carries the border and background; inside, optional leading slot, the editable text element (hooked to the row so focus / hover inherit), and optional trailing slot (clear, password-eye, custom). Below the row, helper or error text renders only when configured.

The text element is always Paper's `TextField` (single-line) or `TextArea` (multi-line). Origami adds chrome, slot management, validation, and autocomplete on top.

docs.summary: When true, pressing Enter in a single-line field commits the value and defocuses.
Focus the field on the first frame it appears, and again each time it reappears after not being drawn.

Runs the setter once when an edit is finished instead of on every keystroke: on Enter (single-line), when the focus moves elsewhere, or when the field stops being drawn. Escape drops the edit. Suits names and any value that is costly or undoable to apply.
Render as a search field: leading magnifier, default "Search..." placeholder, clear button.
Mask the value with `maskChar`. Adds a show/hide eye toggle on the right.
Render as a multi-line text area. Height is computed from `rows`.
